title: Causes of Time Lags in Data Used to Determine Eligibility for GSTV – U-Save Rebates
what_it_is: Causes of Time Lags in Data Used to Determine Eligibility for GSTV – U-Save Rebates

sections.label: U-Save rebate errors
sections.summary: A time lag affected about 3,100 households, and 23 U-Save rebates went to households with no Singaporean Citizens due to database errors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: While we try to strive to keep our data updated as soon as possible, there are practical constraints.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: This time lag issue affected about 3,100 households, or about 0.3% of all households living in HDB flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: There were another 23 cases of U-Save rebates given even though there were no Singaporean Citizens in the household, due to errors in agencies' databases.

sections.label: Recovery and process tightening
sections.summary: MOF has begun recovering rebates from ineligible households and is working with data agencies to tighten processes using latest data.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: MOF has commenced recovery of the rebates given to ineligible households.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: We are working with data agencies to tighten our operational processes to ensure the use of latest available data to administer the GSTV – U-Save scheme.

sections.label: Questions on clawback and households
sections.summary: The Member asks how many households had amounts clawed back and whether further action will identify other households beyond the 3,166.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: How many households have actually had the amounts clawed backed from them?

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: And the last point: there were 3,166 ineligible households identified.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Is there any further action that will be taken to identify whether there are any other households involved in this or is the number of households already taken as 3,166?

sections.label: ICA holds living status information
sections.summary: The agency holding information on living status, whether a person is born or has passed on, is ICA.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The process is the agency that has the information on living status, whether you are born, or whether you have passed on, is ICA.

sections.label: Recovery figures not yet available
sections.summary: The Minister does not have exact recovery figures as the process is ongoing, but assures recovery is being done as soon as possible.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The Member asked if I have the exact figures now, how many have been recovered or not?

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: I do not have the exact figures at the moment, it is still in process, but I think the Member can have the assurance of knowing that we are doing this as soon as we can.
